answer: Under the CERC DSM Regulations 2026, a solar generator is settled against a tolerance band of ±10% of Available Capacity. Deviation beyond that band attracts a charge proportional to the Normal Rate of Charge for Deviation, scaled by the frequency slab at the time of the block. For block 54, the deviation is roughly 2.2% against a 41.0 MW schedule — inside the tolerance band, so only a small charge applies.

citations.snippet: Deviation in excess of the applicable tolerance band shall attract charges computed at the Normal Rate of Charge for Deviation...
For solar generating stations the permissible deviation shall be ten percent of the Available Capacity.
